# Intractify — Private Cloud Browser Platform

> Launch a fully isolated cloud browser session. The browser runs in a per-session container in the cloud — your device is only a viewport. The container is destroyed when your session ends. Pre-launch: no pricing or billing yet.

## Full Reference

For complete technical details, comparison, glossary, and full FAQ:
- [Full reference (llms-full.txt)](https://intractify.com/llms-full.txt)

## What Is Intractify

Intractify is a pre-launch cloud-based privacy platform that provides isolated browser sessions. Each session runs in its own container on cloud infrastructure — your device is only a viewer. Nothing about the browsing itself is stored on your device, and when the session ends the container running the browser is destroyed.

Intractify is built for privacy-conscious individuals, journalists, researchers, security professionals, and teams that want isolated browsing without installing anything.

## How It Works

1. Open https://app.intractify.com and launch a session
2. A fresh container boots a Chromium browser with a clean profile
3. The session is streamed to your browser over a secure WebSocket (noVNC)
4. Browse normally — the cloud browser is your screen, not your device
5. End the session (manually, on idle, or at the max duration) — the container is destroyed
6. Nothing survives the session on your device: no cookies, history, or downloads

## Privacy Architecture

- **Per-session container isolation**: Each session runs in its own container with its own filesystem and network — no shared state between sessions or tenants
- **Nothing on your device**: The browser never runs locally; your device receives only the streamed viewport, so sites cannot read your local hardware, IP, or fonts
- **Ephemeral by design**: Containers are disposable by architecture, not by delete-on-exit policy
- **No local traces**: No cookies, history, or downloads are written to your device
- **Auto-terminate**: Sessions end on idle, on max duration, or at launch-time limits

## Technical Specifications

- Container runtime: per-session container
- Session streaming: pixel stream over WebSocket (noVNC)
- Browser engine: Chromium in a disposable container
- Session lifecycle: starting → active → ended (container destroyed)
- Session start: cold start, provisioned on demand — it can take up to a few minutes

## How Intractify Differs from VPNs and Incognito Mode

**vs. VPN**: A VPN hides your IP but the browser still runs on your device, which can still be fingerprinted. Intractify runs the entire browser in the cloud on a machine that is not yours.

**vs. Incognito / Private mode**: Incognito mode runs locally and only clears history after the session. Intractify's session runs in an isolated cloud container — your device is not executing the browser.

**vs. Tor Browser**: Tor routes traffic through relays but still runs the browser on your device. Intractify runs the browser on cloud infrastructure instead.

Note: Intractify does not claim to hide the fact that you are using a remote browser, and it does not alter the browser's own fingerprint.

## Status

Intractify is **pre-launch**. There is no billing or pricing of any kind yet. Anyone can join the waitlist.

## Data Retention Policy

- Browsing data (URLs, passwords, history, cookies): never stored
- Account data: retained while active; deleted on request
- Session metadata: retained while active for session management

## Security & Compliance

- TLS 1.3 in transit
- GDPR compliant (EU users)
- CCPA compliant (California users)
- Responsible disclosure: security@intractify.com
- Third-party processors: Clerk (authentication), Upstash (cache/queue)

## Common Questions Answered

**Q: Does Intractify store my browsing history?**
A: No. Intractify never logs the URLs visited, passwords typed, screen content, or keyboard input in a session.

**Q: What happens when a session ends?**
A: The container running your browser is destroyed. A new session always starts fresh.

**Q: Can a website tell I'm using a remote browser?**
A: The browser runs on our infrastructure, so a site cannot read your real IP, OS, fonts, or hardware. The session runs the default browser fingerprint of a cloud container; it is not masked, and this is not claimed.

**Q: Does Intractify have pricing?**
A: Not yet. Intractify is pre-launch. Joining the waitlist requires no payment.

**Q: What is browser isolation?**
A: Browser isolation (also called remote browser isolation or RBI) runs the web browser in a remote container rather than on the user's local device. Only the visual output is streamed to the user's screen.
